**Research poster:** *Beyond Quantile Agreement: Decomposing Expected Shortfall Discrepancies in Fire-Loss Models*

**Affiliation:** Department of Mathematics and Statistics, Georgia State University

This page provides the bibliography accompanying the research poster. Entries are transcribed from the reference section of the 60-page research document (pp. 58–60). It does not provide access to unpublished manuscript files or private research data.
